diagnostics_meta.model: FedAvg (Asymmetric) global model, evaluated locally on the edge node
diagnostics_meta.attribution_formula: A_c = mean_t |(x[t,c] - b[t,c]) * dRUL/dx[t,c]|; b = regime-aware healthy baseline; settings forced to 0; share_c = 100*A_c/sum A
diagnostics_meta.drift_formula: z = (regime-standardized sensor - engine healthy mean over first 30 cycles) / pooled healthy noise; window mean
